settings.title: Build performance
settings.description: Cap how long a build may run and how many builds run at once. Extra builds wait in a queue.
settings.timeoutHelp: A build running longer than this is stopped and marked as timed out. 0 means no limit.
settings.concurrentHelp: Builds past this number wait for a free slot. 0 means no limit.
settings.defaultsNote: Defaults come from APP_BUILD_TIMEOUT and APP_BUILD_MAX_CONCURRENT: {{timeout}} minutes and {{concurrent}} builds.
settings.resetDone: Build limits reset to the defaults.
settings.rootOnly: Only a root account can change build limits.
